injectionPoints.rationale: RenderGraph Compute Lab probe texel written unsanitized to RenderGraphCompute.NonFiniteProbe; a boundary scan must report its exact location.
Register-only RenderGraph Compute Lab preview value passed through a sanitizing write; the PNG stays unchanged while the site counter must fail or apply its clamp policy.
Temporal AA history read (RGB color, alpha accumulation) before the recovery guards; the recovery branch hides the value from resource scans.
